
A fan rebuild of Mercenaries 2: World in Flames. It needs your own
installed copy of the PC game, which it reads; it brings none of the
game's files.

Run m2-beta.exe. If a friend's invite link copied an invite, it joins
them. To host: run m2-beta.exe --host; once it is up, the invite
link is on your clipboard to paste to a friend.

Source: https://github.com/bstoney-yt/Mercenaries-2-Decompilation
